Row.Text: Choose whole-map placement or an East vs West competitive layout. Every solved start requires Fresh Water and 12 tiles of separation.
Search the whole eligible map for Fresh Water starts at least 12 tiles apart; retain all original starts if no complete solution exists.
Two-player East vs West placement: Slot 1 starts anywhere across the western side and Slot 2 anywhere across the eastern side. On the Tiny Map Size the map is built as a 36x22 Duel map.
Four-player East vs West placement: Slots 1/2 backline and Slots 3/4 frontline.
Six-player East vs West placement: Slots 1-4 backline and Slots 5/6 frontline.
Eight-player East vs West placement: Slots 1-4 backline and Slots 5-8 frontline.
How strongly leaders and civilizations are held to their start biases. Fresh Water and 12-tile separation are always required.
The game's own weighted start biases only.

Strict start biases: supported leaders and civilizations must start on or near their terrain, and the game's weighted biases rank the qualifying tiles. All players are warned if a requirement cannot be met.
Which resources the map uses and the rules they follow. Resource Amount and Resource Clusters apply to either list.
The game's own resources for each Age, with their usual placement rules, yields and effects.

Every resource in every Age (Oil and Rubber from Modern), kept across Age transitions: matched resource pools dealt to each player's region, even counts of general resources per continent, and the mod's own classes, yields and effects.

How many resources the map places, as a share of the game's own density. With Resource List Standard, every continent keeps at least one of each resource the game placed there, so Scarce and Sparse can place more on small continents.
Whether resources gather into patches of the same resource. The amount stays the same.
Resources are spread out one by one.
Half of the deposits grow into patches of 2.
Three quarters of the deposits grow into patches of up to 3.
One large central Pangaea; the islands beyond its coasts are the Distant Lands.
